ex.s: 你打嚟做咩？發生咩事呀？
ex.r: nei5 daa2 lai4 zou6 me1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 aa3
ex.en: Why are you calling? What happened?

ex.r: gung1 si1 faat3 sang1 zo2 di1 man6 tai4
ex.en: Some problems came up at the company.

ex.s: 屋企冇發生咩事，放心啦。
ex.r: uk1 kei2 mou5 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 fong3 sam1 laa1
ex.en: Nothing happened at home, don't worry.

fix.note: Used to agree: 冇錯 = exactly.

ex.r: mou5 co3 zau6 hai6 keoi5
ex.en: That's right, it's him.

ex.s: 冇錯呀，呢間餐廳真係好好食。
ex.r: mou5 co3 aa3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 sik6
ex.en: Exactly, this restaurant really is great.

ex.r: nei5 gai3 dak1 mou5 co3 hai6 jat1 baak3 man1
ex.en: You worked it out right, it's a hundred dollars.

fix.en: by then; when the time comes

ex.r: dou3 si4 gin3 laa1
ex.en: See you then!

ex.r: ngo5 dou3 si4 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5
ex.en: I'll call you when the time comes.

ex.r: dou3 si4 lok6 jyu5 dim2 syun3 aa3
ex.en: What if it rains then?

fix.note: 點算好？ = What should I do?

ex.r: m4 gin3 zo2 so2 si4 dim2 syun3 aa3
ex.en: I've lost my keys, what do I do?

ex.r: lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5 gam1 jat6 dim2 syun3 hou2
ex.en: It's pouring, what should we do today?

ex.r: keoi5 m4 teng1 din6 waa2 dim2 syun3
ex.en: She's not picking up the phone, what now?

fix.en: to be afraid of; to worry that
fix.note: Like 驚. 我怕… also means 'I'm worried that…'.

ex.r: ngo5 hou2 paa3 se4
ex.en: I'm really scared of snakes.

ex.r: ngo5 paa3 keoi5 m4 gei3 dak1
ex.en: I'm worried she'll forget.

ex.s: 佢好怕凍，成日著好多衫。
ex.r: keoi5 hou2 paa3 dung3 seng4 jat6 zoek3 hou2 do1 saam1
ex.en: She really feels the cold, she always wears lots of layers.

ex.r: nei5 haak3 can1 ngo5 aa3
ex.en: You scared me!

ex.r: m4 hou2 haak3 go3 sai3 lou6
ex.en: Don't frighten the kid.

ex.r: go3 gaa3 cin4 haak3 sei2 jan4
ex.en: The price is shocking.

ex.r: maak3 daai6 go3 hau2
ex.en: Open your mouth wide.

ex.s: 個細路成日將啲玩具放落口。
ex.r: go3 sai3 lou6 seng4 jat6 zoeng1 di1 wun6 geoi6 fong3 lok6 hau2
ex.en: The kid keeps putting toys in his mouth.

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 mun4 hau2 dang2 nei5
ex.en: I'll wait for you at the door.

fix.note: Can split: 結咗婚 = got married.

ex.r: keoi5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 git3 fan1
ex.en: They're getting married next month.

ex.r: nei5 dei6 git3 fan1 gei2 noi6 laa3
ex.en: How long have you been married?

ex.s: 我表姐結婚請咗兩百個人。
ex.r: ngo5 biu2 ze2 git3 fan1 ceng2 zo2 loeng5 baak3 go3 jan4
ex.en: My cousin invited 200 people to her wedding.

ex.r: ngo5 luk6 jyut6 fong3 syu2 gaa3
ex.en: My summer vacation starts in June.

ex.s: 六月好熱，記得飲多啲水。
ex.r: luk6 jyut6 hou2 jit6 gei3 dak1 jam2 do1 di1 seoi2
ex.en: June is really hot, remember to drink plenty of water.

ex.r: keoi5 saang1 jat6 hai2 luk6 jyut6
ex.en: Her birthday is in June.

notes: Mostly accurate. Fixed: unnatural 冇事發生 and 唔怕 lines; 二百→兩百; 玩具 to standard wun6; illogical umbrella-for-heat line; pos for 冇錯/到時/點算; awkward English gloss.
